messages:
ellie: Taking over the bridge from @kevin — I'm joining now. There's an active P1 (embeddings latency/error spike) affecting euw1 and aps1, customer-facing error rate ~5%. paging triggered ~2m ago. I'm on shift handoff; need to confirm driver/comms ownership before I step out for a brief handover.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 #5342 — High embeddings latency (euw1, aps1). Pages sent to @eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5342. Severity: P1. Current status: investigating.

sam: I can drive this for the next 30m but FYI — I'm in the middle of a small infra deploy (shouldn't conflict). If I take driver, someone needs to own comms.

maria: I'll take comms. Posting initial customer-facing note to #status-updates and opening a ticket in Zendesk. Draft: "We are investigating increased latency for embeddings in EU-W and APAC. No indication of data loss. Engineers are actively investigating; updates every 15m." Will post now. :loudspeaker:

ellie: Thanks. Calling it out clearly: primary driver = sam (temporary), secondary/backup = kevin (will pick up if sam drops). comms = maria. Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency.md. Steps I'm running now: check prefix cache, examine recent model variant rollouts, and confirm routing.

ellie: Quick checks I'm doing:
```
# check health endpoints
curl -sS https://euw1-infer.redwood/api/v1/health | jq .
# tail recent worker logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embeddings -c worker --since=10m | tail -n 200
```

sam: On it. First thing I'll do is reduce batch size to limit tail latency and check kernel fallback on the model runtime. Applying hotfix to staging then prod if green. Patch I'm about to push: set BATCH_MAX=4 and disable auto-batching for the affected model id.

sam: Patching now. Command: 
```
redwoodctl rollout set-config --service=embeddings --model-id=redwood-embed-v2 --env=prod --set BATCH_MAX=4
```

kevin: Heads-up — APAC (aps1) currently has only a single dedicated pool for embeddings because of yesterday's capacity change. If we reduce batching, we might increase throughput and hit the pool limit. I'm standing by to spin up burst nodes if needed (will take ~8-12m). I'm also not fully handed off yet; if it escalates while I'm still switching, ask PagerDuty to notify my mobile.

maria: Posted initial status and linked the incident. Also pinged support to prioritize any customer tickets from the affected regions. Updating customers with next ETA ~20-30m.

ellie: Noted coverage gap: APAC driver overlap is thin for the next 30m (kevin is mid-handshake). Sam, if you start the patch and need to abort, set rollback token `rb-5342` and alert kevin.

sam: Patch applied to canary; latency improved on canary pods. Running canary for 5m before rolling prod. Canary logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T10:42:03Z] embeddings-worker-2: avg_lat=180ms -> 90ms after BATCH_MAX change
```

maria: Comms update posted: "Investigating increased latency for embeddings in EU and APAC. A temporary performance patch is being rolled out; next update in 15 minutes." :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder: handoff window for ellie ends in 10m. Use /handoff to transfer active incident ownership.

ellie: I'm going to step out to handle a quick customer call — handing bridge to sam as primary driver now. Maria continues comms. Kevin remains secondary and will prep burst capacity (start if latency regresses or error rate climbs). If anything spikes, @kevin +@ellie mobile pages enabled.

sam: I accept driver handoff. I'll keep the canary running and start prod rollout in 2m if no regression. Will call for capacity scale if throughput increases beyond pool capacity.

kevin: Acknowledged and on stand-by. If sam needs scale, I'll start dedicated-burst APAC job: `dedicated.scale --region=aps1 --pool=embeds-burst --count=3`. ETA ~10m once triggered.

ellie: Leaving brief checklist in thread for whoever picks up: 1) confirm canary metrics (lat, p95, error-rate) 2) check model variant routing 3) be ready to scale APAC pool 4) keep comms cadence (every 15m).

maria: Will post next customer update at +15m. Also adding a note to the incident doc about the handoff owners and gap window.

sam: Prod rollout started — incremental 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitoring p95 and errors. Will abort on error-rate >1% absolute increase.

ellie: Thanks team. Handed off fully to sam (driver) and maria (comms). I'm available on mobile for escalations but stepping out of the bridge for 20m.

maria: Acknowledged. Continuing comms. Next update scheduled at 10:57Z.

sam: Canary to 50% looks stable. No error increase, p95 down ~70ms. Proceeding to 100% now.

kevin: Starting APAC burst standby pre-warm (won't attach unless triggered) — should reduce scale time if needed.

ellie: (final) Thanks all — documented the handoff: primary=sam, secondary=kevin, comms=maria. Coverage gap noted for APAC during 10:40-11:00Z window; mitigation: kevin pre-warm.

sam: Will close the loop when post-rollout metrics are stable.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 #5342 status: Mitigation in progress. Owner: sam. Comms: maria.

sam: Closing the bridge in 30m if metrics remain steady; will file follow-up postmortem checklist with timeline and root-candidate notes.
